title: Efficient primal-dual algorithm for imaging applications with matrix stacking, applied to DBT image reconstruction
summary: The primal-dual hybrid gradient (PDHG) algorithm for solving convex optimization problems that arise in tomographic imaging is revisited. In particular, simplification of the selection of step-size parameters is developed for optimization problems with multiple terms, each containing a linear transform subject to splitting. This simplification maintains algorithm efficiency while avoiding massive grid searches for the optimal parameter settings.
